system.description: • Effect: You choose a Path, a patron within it and a Pact (see Patron Paths and Pacts). Your Path gives its passive and one gift; your patron its boon; your Pact its frame, its core feature and two invocations.

activities.name: Hellfire Rebuke
activities.text: Infernal (1st). Once per round, out of turn, when a creature damages you: it takes fire damage, no save. From 15th (The Pact Deepens) half as many dice again.

activities.name: Binding Contract
activities.text: Infernal (1st). A creature within 60ft makes a Will save. On a failure it can't attack you or target you with a spell until the end of its next turn, and it answers one question you ask truthfully.

activities.name: Ice Tomb
activities.text: Infernal (8th). A creature within 60ft makes a Fortitude save or is Paralysed in ice for 1 minute, with Resistance to all damage but fire while encased. It saves again at the end of each of its turns.

activities.name: Fallen Light
activities.text: Infernal (8th). A 30ft-radius burst on a point within 60ft, sparing creatures you choose: Reflex halves. Roll the damage below: 4d8 fire, or 8d8 radiant against undead and fiends (half as many dice again from 15th).

activities.name: Fallen Light: fire
activities.text: Fallen Light's damage to most creatures (Reflex halves).

activities.name: Fallen Light: radiant
activities.text: Fallen Light's damage to undead and fiends (Reflex halves).

activities.name: Raise the Fallen
activities.text: Abyss (1st, no Favour). A creature you kill with Eldritch Blast, a cantrip or a spell rises as a zombie at the start of your next turn. One at a time; it counts as one of your servants.

activities.name: Maddening Gaze
activities.text: Abyss (1st). A creature within 60ft makes a Will save or is Terrified until the end of its next turn (it doesn't have to flee); on a natural 1, it is also Stunned.

activities.name: Bestial Fury
activities.text: Abyss (8th). For the encounter, the first attack against you each round has Disadvantage, and you can't be Charmed or Frightened. You can't cast spells with slots while it lasts; Eldritch Blast still works.

activities.name: The Hunt
activities.text: Abyss (8th). Mark a creature within 120ft for the encounter. You know where it is; one damaging spell or blast of yours each round deals extra damage to it (below); and once during the encounter, when it would drop you to 0 HP, you drop to 1 instead.

activities.name: The Hunt: extra damage
activities.text: Once each round, on one damaging spell or blast against your marked creature.

activities.name: Shadow Step
activities.text: Fey (1st). Step into a shadow within 10ft and out of another within 60ft. You may take one willing creature beside you along.

activities.name: Summer's Fury
activities.text: Fey (1st). Once per round, when a creature within 30ft fails a save against a damaging effect of yours, every die of that effect against it counts as its highest.

activities.name: Unseelie Shroud
activities.text: Fey (8th). A creature within 60ft makes a Will save or for 1 minute is Blinded, has its speed halved and has Disadvantage on saves; it saves again at the end of each of its turns. This doesn't apply to an effect that kills outright.

activities.name: Wild Growth
activities.text: Fey (8th). A 20ft radius on a point within 60ft. Each enemy there makes a Fortitude save or is Restrained, saving again at the end of each of its turns.

activities.name: Unravel
activities.text: Great Old One (1st). A creature or object within 30ft makes a Fortitude save: it takes the damage below (half on a success), and attacks against it have Advantage until the end of your next turn.

activities.name: Unravel: damage
activities.text: Unravel's necrotic damage (Fortitude halves). From 15th (The Pact Deepens) half as many dice again.

activities.name: The Truth Beneath
activities.text: Great Old One (1st). You gain True Seeing for 1 minute.

activities.name: Far Realm Rift
activities.text: Great Old One (8th). A 20ft radius on a point within 60ft. Each creature there makes a Will save or is Stunned for 1 round and takes the damage below. The rift lingers one round: a creature that enters it or starts its turn there saves again.

activities.name: Far Realm Rift: damage
activities.text: Far Realm Rift's psychic damage, on a failed save.

activities.name: Eye of Bolothamogg
activities.text: Great Old One (8th). An eye (AC 15, 30 HP) appears within 60ft for 3 rounds. On each of your turns it fires a ray at a creature it can see (below). A creature it kills is disintegrated.

activities.name: Eye of Bolothamogg: ray
activities.text: The eye's ray, once on each of your turns (Reflex halves).
